controller: real BadugiGameController through JSONL Python bridge
reward: terminal target-seat chip delta / active hand big blind; zero at intermediate target decisions
segmentRule: Continue the exact optimizer-bearing alternative checkpoint 24 for four isolated 5,000-hand segments, runs 25-28. Keep the balanced curriculum of 200 Pro bootstrap hands, 200 imitation steps and one Pro anchor per ten RL hands in each segment. Every segment allocates 125 hands to each of the 40 seat/mode/opponent cells. New seed windows are disjoint from all recorded D03 training/evaluation sessions at freeze time, including the ongoing frozen Pro comparison. Audit every segment before the next GO; stop on safety, resource or provenance failure. Do not use ongoing final-evaluation results for model selection or curriculum changes. Training is not strength proof.
dataBoundary: Training seeds and all previous H33b or Phase 1 diagnostic seeds are excluded from future candidate final evaluation. Pro anchor uses only actor observation and legal mask; scripted opponent profile is not an input.
publication: No public model, registry, release or Iron adoption from this plan. Independent final 40-cell session evaluation, unknown opponents, human review and Company OS gate are separate.
